title: LocalGovBench v0.2.0: Disclosure Affordances in Public AI and Algorithm Registers
description:
LocalGovBench v0.2.0 is a reproducible research software deposit for studying schema disclosure affordance in public AI and algorithm registers using Disclosure Functions v1. It includes the normative function catalogue, field-normalization and candidate-mapping artefacts, corpus-lock and schema-inventory tooling, and a human schema-coding system (codebook, templates, validation utilities, double-coding and adjudication protocols).

This version is a framework transition relative to LocalGovBench v0.1.0 (Governance Readiness Benchmark; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20543779). Historical v0.1.0 materials remain for provenance and are not the active analytical framework.

v0.2.0 does not claim completed human coding results, IRR statistics, realization tables, affordance–realization gap figures, jurisdiction rankings, readiness/maturity scores, shortfall scores, compliance scores, or a finished journal manuscript.
